source.acip: ZAG MED KYI LAS NI MI DKAR MI GNAG RNAM PAR MI SMIN LA, NAG PO DE ZAD PAR BYED PA YIN NO,
source.wylie: zag med kyi las ni mi dkar mi gnag rnam par mi smin la, nag po de zad par byed pa yin no
source.english: Deeds which are unstained never ripen into anything either white or black. Their nature is to be what brings "it"--that is, the black kind of deed--to an end. 64 Bringing Black and White Deeds to an End

Complete negative ripening construction preserves overt negation; individual mi outside this phrase also share the wider coordinated scope.
Second black is in GMR explanatory apposition identifying the object that is ended, not the first negative classification or heading.
Demonstrative refers to the black deed and is rendered by quoted it; quote marks stay outside.
Exhaustion root corresponds to the nominal end in the causative brings...to an end construction; intervening object excludes a contiguous whole-causative span.
Causative doing verb provides brings; argument and to an remain unwrapped.
